data.rationale: The proposal follows the right sequence (Booking search, then Xe EUR conversion, then mail draft with the correct subject and body), but it misses the "first hotel with score ≥8" rule, uses a vague hotel_choice parameter, treats the recipient as a full address instead of {traveler}@example.com, leaves the body's {name} unclear, and says to Send when the true workflow says never to send and to click Discard.
